text: Artificial intelligence is changing the modern workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, such as data entry, so employees can focus on more interesting work. Productivity tools powered by AI help people write emails, schedule meetings, and organise information faster. Many companies also encourage human-AI collaboration, where workers use smart systems to make better decisions. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI can make work easier and more efficient, but it also requires people to adapt to a rapidly changing environment.
